title: Common Knowledge
source: Starter aerodynamics, weather, regs & ADM vocabulary

terms.definition: Angle between the chord line and the relative wind; stall depends on AOA, not airspeed alone.
Airflow opposite the flight path as felt by the wing; changes with climb, descent, and turns.
Rising column of warmer air used for soaring climb; often marked by cumulus or dust/debris.
Change of wind speed with height; important in the pattern because groundspeed and sink change near the surface.
Aeronautical Decision Making — systematic process to identify hazards and choose a safe course of action.
ADM hazard areas: Pilot, Aircraft, enVironment, External pressures.
In soaring traffic, lower aircraft and those on final generally have priority; join thermals considerately and predictably.
Pressure altitude corrected for nonstandard temperature — high DA means thinner air and reduced performance.
